replies.author: Two_Become_One
replies.body:
Hello,

I know i didn't say anything in game, it was because the only way the punishment can go through is if you show me a recording of the player team-killing or if the mod sees the player team-killing. I was playing in that game and obviously i didn't see him do it.

On a different note: Use this thread when trying to upload photos. Right now you are just showing me where the photos are on your computer, which doesn't help cause i can't view them.

So as of now this report is denied. In the future for this type of punishment try to record or get a mod into the game before  the player team-kills,


Regards, 
Devil_Fruit, Senior Mod.
